collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen has made a stew so spicy that two people had to sit in the stream afterwards.

description_variants.description: An Isolan has made a stew so spicy that two people had to sit in the stream afterwards.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has made a stew so spicy that two people have had to sit in the stream afterwards. (He/she) is very proud. Some of the camp would like a word.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) makes a milder one the next night. Everyone eats it gratefully. A few people quietly ask whether there's any of the spicy one left.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) stands firm. "It's supposed to make your eyes water." Within a month, half the camp can't eat anything else.
